description_en: Queries the parsing data of a specified card SMS template. The parsing data includes the number of successful SMS parsing receipts, the number of message exposures, and the number of message clicks
description_zh: 查询卡片短信指定模板的解析数据，解析数据包括短信解析回执成功数、消息曝光次数和消息点击数等
name: QueryCardSmsTemplateReport

parameters.help_en: The start time. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end time. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: end_date

Code.description_en:
The request status code.

The value OK indicates that the request was successful.

For information about other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。

其他错误码请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）

items.description_en:
The details of the returned data.
tmpCode: the template code.
date: the data date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.
rptSuccessCount: the number of successful SMS parsing receipts.
exposeUv: the number of message exposure UVs.
exposePv: the number of message exposure PVs.
clickUv: the number of message click UVs.
clickPv: the number of message click PVs.
facPvUvList: the list of vendor information
items.description_zh:
返回数据明细。
tmpCode：模板Code。
date：数据日期。格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
rptSuccessCount：短信解析回执成功数。
exposeUv：消息曝光数。
exposePv：消息曝光次数。
clickUv：消息点击数。
clickPv：消息点击次数。
facPvUvList：厂商信息列表

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
